# Legacy state fixture

`dmg-v0.6.state` was generated by the untouched 0.6 core from the user-supplied project archive using its original `demo.gb`. It contains 17 runFrame calls, 1,193,808 base clocks and 14 visible PPU frames (LCD-off upload accounts for the difference).

It is original homebrew demo state, not a Nintendo game or boot ROM. The memory test copies both ROM and state to a temporary directory, loads the real v3 layout, and compares two identical future continuations after restoring it.

## SameBoy v17 PPU fixture

`sameboy-v17-cgbc.state` is a genuine **version 17 native layout**, freshly regenerated on 18 October 2026 using the untouched core from commit `be634cd53f80b56dae9d9db41cb9a5d28bd19ce4` (GCC 14.2.0, Linux x86-64, `GB_VERSION="1.0.4"`). It contains a synthetic zero-filled 32 KiB CGB ROM, a PPU checkpoint at display state 44, VRAM byte `$04D6 = $A5`, and WRAM byte `$0123 = $94`. No game or boot firmware is embedded. Its BESS section allows v18 to recover portable machine state; exact old PPU phase restoration is deliberately rejected.

Producer: [`../make_v17_ppu_state_fixture.c`](../make_v17_ppu_state_fixture.c). The producer refuses any `STRUCT_VERSION` other than 17. The pristine source was preserved in a separate worktree before the v18 edits.

Reproduce from the project root:

```sh
git worktree add --detach /tmp/gb-window-v17 be634cd53f80b56dae9d9db41cb9a5d28bd19ce4
cmake -S /tmp/gb-window-v17 -B /tmp/gb-v17-build -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF
cmake --build /tmp/gb-v17-build --target gb_accuracy
cc -std=gnu11 -DGB_INTERNAL -D_GNU_SOURCE \
  -DGB_DISABLE_DEBUGGER -DGB_DISABLE_CHEAT_SEARCH -DGB_DISABLE_CHEATS \
  -DGB_DISABLE_REWIND -DGB_DISABLE_TIMEKEEPING \
  -I/tmp/gb-window-v17/third_party/sameboy/Core \
  tests/make_v17_ppu_state_fixture.c /tmp/gb-v17-build/libgb_accuracy.a \
  -lm -o /tmp/make-v17-ppu-state
/tmp/make-v17-ppu-state tests/fixtures/sameboy-v17-cgbc.state
```

Two fresh producer executions generated byte-identical 83,452-byte files. SHA256 matches the fixture produced before the environment reset:

```text
3b7b269b68dfd934708099cf8a1fd108d3e80d8e6a4455323993f6ef7afe6a2c  sameboy-v17-cgbc.state
38205f85104b0c1c89816343cf6101dd51d0c27d14b7476d77316e16a4a26d6d  ../make_v17_ppu_state_fixture.c
```

The state test also relabels current snapshots as v16/v17 to exercise the incompatible-version guard. Those checks are explicitly synthetic; they do not claim authentic v16 layout coverage. The separate genuine v17 fixture tests the actual older layout, portable BESS import, marker preservation, and rejection when its BESS blocks are removed. Historical authentic v16 migration results remain in `docs/stage2-state-fallback.json`.
